answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with bonded attestations: to count as one voter, an agent locks a slashable stake and gathers signed vouchers from unrelated peers. A clone cannot manufacture independent vouchers, so an attacker must fund a fresh bond and vouchers for every fake identity, and caught clones lose their stake. Much as a glacier, an island, and karst are each a distinct landform, every bond anchors one agent, so forging many identities costs many stakes.
